purpose: Teach: 育毛/素顔/投球/真珠/灯油/ゾウ/主食/鯛

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の父ちゃん、育毛気にしてんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, your dad's pretty worried about his hair thinning, isn't he?
lines.style: Teasing lilt on the question. Quick, knowingly amused. Leans into the observation like it's a joke they both get. Not mean — just finding the funny in something she noticed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、素顔の方が可愛いのに化粧すんな、桜
lines.en: You're cuter without makeup, Sakura — why do you even bother?
lines.style: Deadpan deflection. Drops the observation casual, like he's just stating fact. Eyes stay steady. Quieter underneath — he didn't mean to say that out loud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、野球部で投球練習やってんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you've been doing throwing drills with the baseball team lately, haven't you?
lines.style: Curious, observant tone. Pace picks up slightly — she's following a thread she noticed. Not accusatory, just calling out that she pays attention to what he does.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、誕生日に真珠もらったろ?桜
lines.en: You got pearls for your birthday, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet counter-observation. Steady, knowing. He's matching her move — calling out something he noticed about her. Not defensive, just evening the score.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、灯油ストーブまだ使ってんの?
lines.en: Riku, your house still uses one of those old kerosene heaters?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity with a hint of amusement. The question is casual, like she's just piecing together something small about him. Warmth underneath — she's noticing the details that matter.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゾウのキャラ好きだろ?桜
lines.en: You really like elephant characters, don't you?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation with a small smile in the voice. Acknowledges something soft about him without making it weird. Easy, not mocking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お米が主食派だろ?
lines.en: Riku, you're the type to eat rice as your main staple, right?
lines.style: Playful cataloguing tone. She's building a picture of him — small detail by small detail. Curious, not prying. A little amused at how predictable he is.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食の鯛料理、おかわりしたろ?桜
lines.en: You asked for seconds on that sea bream they served at lunch, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, satisfied delivery. He's building his own catalogue of her — matching her move with precision. Small laugh underneath, like he caught her in something sweet.
